landing.heroBadge: Next-Generation Load Calculation & Electrical Design System
landing.heroDesc: Streamline building load calculations, cable schedule sizing, breaker coordination, single-line diagrams (SLD), and professional printable PDF reports for industrial projects.
landing.loadDesc: Calculate connected load, max demand, and 3-phase balancing (L1, L2, L3) with custom diversity and expansion factors.
landing.cableDesc: Automatic conductor sizing, ampacity derating, short-circuit withstand, and voltage drop compliance checks to IEC 60364-5-52.
landing.breakersDesc: Coordinate time-current characteristic (TCC) curves between main and branch circuit breakers for optimal selectivity.
landing.panelDesc: Design distribution board layouts, busbar ratings, phase balancing (R-Y-B), and spare circuit allocations.
landing.sldDesc: Generate dynamic single line diagrams and vertical building riser trees automatically linked to project data.

tour.welcomeDesc: Let's take a quick interactive tour to explore how ProCal streamlines standard-compliant electrical engineering design.

dashboard.title: Dashboard & Engineering Metrics
dashboard.subtitle: Real-Time Project Overview
dashboard.content: Welcome to ProCal! The Dashboard provides real-time statistics on active electrical loads, maximum demand, and overall project summaries.

projects.title: Projects & Building Management
projects.subtitle: Manage Projects & Buildings
projects.content: Manage your engineering project portfolio, create new projects, and configure multi-building complexes (residential towers, commercial malls, office blocks).

calculator.title: Load Calculator & Phase Balancing
calculator.subtitle: Electrical Demand & Neutral Current
calculator.content: Calculate load currents, power factor displacement angles, demand factors, and vector 3-phase neutral unbalance across all floors.

cableSchedule.title: Cable Schedule & Derating
cableSchedule.subtitle: IEC 60364 Cable Sizing
cableSchedule.content: Automatically size copper/aluminum XLPE cables based on installation methods, ambient temperature, grouping factors, and voltage drop limits.

breakerSchedule.title: Breaker Schedule & Selection
breakerSchedule.subtitle: MCB, MCCB & ACB Catalog Matching
breakerSchedule.content: Match miniature circuit breakers (MCB), molded case circuit breakers (MCCB), and air circuit breakers (ACB) from Schneider, ABB, and Siemens.

panelDesigner.title: Panel Designer & Main Incomer
panelDesigner.subtitle: Busbar & Switchboard Configuration
panelDesigner.content: Configure main distribution boards (MDB) and sub-distribution boards (SMDB), transformer secondaries, and main busbar current ratings.

riserDiagram.title: Riser Diagram & Feeder Distribution
riserDiagram.subtitle: Vertical Building Power Distribution
riserDiagram.content: Visualize vertical electrical risers, feeder distribution trunks, and sub-panel floor connections throughout multi-story structures.

coordination.title: Protection Coordination
coordination.subtitle: Selectivity & Trip Curves
coordination.content: Analyze protection selectivity, discrimination, and tripping characteristics between upstream MCCBs/ACBs and downstream MCBs.

sldDesigner.title: SLD Designer Workstation
sldDesigner.subtitle: Interactive Single Line Diagrams
sldDesigner.content: Inspect floor-by-floor Single Line Diagrams with collapsible tree explorer, interactive node details, and live schematic rendering.

reports.title: Executive PDF Reports
reports.subtitle: Print & Export Drawing Packages
reports.content: Generate executive summary cover reports with color-coded key performance cards, distribution hierarchy tables, and complete landscape drawing packages.

settings.title: Workspace Settings & Controls
settings.subtitle: Customization & Replay
settings.content: Configure country engineering defaults, company logos, voltage drop limits, or replay this guided product tour anytime!

calcSummary.title: Load Demand Summary & Incomer Current
calcSummary.subtitle: Aggregated Electrical Demands
calcSummary.content: View total connected load (kW), maximum demand after diversity factors, and calculated incomer line current (A) for your selected building.

calcBuildings.title: Building Selector & Multi-Structure Tabs
calcBuildings.subtitle: Complex Building Tabs
calcBuildings.content: Switch between individual towers, commercial blocks, or podium buildings in your project to calculate their independent load schedules.

calcBuildingLoads.title: Mechanical & Central Building Loads
calcBuildingLoads.subtitle: Elevators, Pumps & Plant Equipment
calcBuildingLoads.content: Configure shared building mechanical loads such as passenger elevators, domestic booster pumps, and HVAC chillers.

calcFloors.title: Floor Load Designs & 3-Phase Phase Balance
calcFloors.subtitle: Floor Breakdown & Neutral Current
calcFloors.content: Inspect floor-by-floor loads, apartment template densities, and automatic vector phase balancing (L1, L2, L3) to prevent neutral overload.

cableHeader.title: Cable Schedule & IEC 60364 Sizing
cableHeader.subtitle: Conductor Sizing Standards
cableHeader.content: Automatically size phase conductors, neutral conductors, and protective earth (PE) conductors in compliance with IEC 60364-5-52.

cableDerating.title: Derating Factors & Installation Methods
cableDerating.subtitle: Insulation & Ambient Conditions
cableDerating.content: Configure cable insulation (XLPE/PVC), installation method (perforated tray, direct buried, conduit), ambient temperature, and grouping derating factors.

cableTable.title: Calculated Cable Sizing Table
cableTable.subtitle: Cross-Sections & Voltage Drop
cableTable.content: Review recommended conductor cross-sections (mm²), voltage drop percentage (%ΔV), and short-circuit withstand capability.

breakerHeader.title: Breaker Schedule & Catalog Selector
breakerHeader.subtitle: Manufacturer Database Matching
breakerHeader.content: Match circuit breakers across MCB, MCCB, and ACB categories from Schneider Electric, ABB, and Siemens catalog databases.

breakerFamilySelect.title: Default Breaker Family Selection
breakerFamilySelect.subtitle: Configured Series & Product Lines
breakerFamilySelect.content: Configure default series (e.g. Acti9 iC60N, ComPacT NSX, MasterPact MTZ) for final distribution and main incomers.

breakerTable.title: Distribution Circuit Breaker Table
breakerTable.subtitle: Trip Ratings & Breaking Capacity
breakerTable.content: Inspect nominal trip ratings (In), pole configurations (1P/3P/4P), breaking capacities (Icu), and trip unit parameters.

sldHeader.title: Single Line Diagram (SLD) Workstation
sldHeader.subtitle: Interactive CAD Schematic Editor
sldHeader.content: View, edit, and export floor-by-floor Single Line Diagrams with live schematic rendering and component hierarchy.

sldTree.title: Distribution Hierarchy Explorer
sldTree.subtitle: Sub-Panel Tree Navigation
sldTree.content: Navigate incomer transformers, main distribution boards (MDB), sub-main panels (SMDB), and final distribution boards (FDB).

sldCanvas.title: Schematic Diagram Canvas & Print Controls
sldCanvas.subtitle: Live CAD View & PDF Export
sldCanvas.content: Inspect electrical schematic symbols, breaker ratings, cable tags, and print full-bleed landscape PDF engineering drawing sheets.

slideshow.heading: Explore ProCal in Action
slideshow.subheading: Click through the core functions below to see how ProCal streamlines complex electrical design tasks.

loadCalc.title: Building Load & Phase Balancing
loadCalc.description: Calculate connected and diversified power across complex multi-floor structures. Automatically balance loads across R-Y-B phases with real-time total kVA and current demand updates.

cableSizing.title: Cable Schedule & Voltage Drop Sizing
cableSizing.description: Automate conductor sizing, insulation selection, and derating factors. Validates allowable voltage drop percentages for feeder and branch circuits automatically.
cableSizing.h3: Exact voltage drop % & thermal stress limits

sldDiagram.title: Interactive Single Line Diagrams (SLD)
sldDiagram.description: Convert load schedules into high-resolution single line diagrams and building vertical risers linked directly to circuit protection parameters and busbars.
sldDiagram.h3: Real-time schematic updates from schedule data

breakerSchedule.title: Circuit Breaker & Protection Selection
breakerSchedule.description: Match protection devices against calculated short circuit currents (kA). Select exact trip frame sizes, breaking capacities, and thermal-magnetic trip curves.
breakerSchedule.h1: MCCB, MCB, ACB, and ELCB/RCD catalog match
breakerSchedule.h3: Custom trip setting and frame size selection

pdfReports.title: Printable PDF Reports & Bill of Materials
pdfReports.description: Generate submission-ready PDF packages including calculation covers, schedule tables, bill of materials (BOM), and high-resolution SLD diagrams in seconds.
pdfReports.h1: Customizable project cover page & approval stamps
pdfReports.h3: Printable high-res vector PDF diagrams & schedules
